{"metadata":{"description":"DSH WebUI 深链插件：?session=/?workspace= 直接打开指定项目对话","id":"gh:1333119284","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-deeplink","slug":"qyw233/dsh-deeplink","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH WebUI 深链插件：?session=/?workspace= 直接打开指定项目对话"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-deeplink — WebUI deep-link plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that opens a **specific project conversation** directly from a URL "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"query parameter, instead of always returning to the last session."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- `?session=<session-id>` → open that conversation
- `?workspace=<workspace-id>` → open that project"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"'s latest/blank conversation
- Persistent links: the address bar follows the current conversation, s"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"o you can copy/bookmark/share the link at any time
- Settings toggles to enable/disable jumping and "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"address-bar following independently
- Ships a model prompt section so the model surfaces clickable d"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"eep links when a reply refers to another conversation or project"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"License: MIT"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Reads `?session=` / `?workspace=` from the page URL and switches once the session/workspace list b"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"aseline is ready

No history pollution, no reload
- Settings toggles: two independent switches (设置 → 插件 → 插件配置, "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"shown as a card via the official `settings.plugin.item` slot, keyed by the `dsh-deeplink` settings n"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"amespace) — `jump` (process `?session=`/`?workspace=` on load, default on) and `follow` (address-bar"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" following, default on), both persisted in `localStorage`
- The node half registers a global prompt "},{"id":"p7s11","text":"section so the model knows deep links exist and can attach links when a reply refers to other conver"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"sations/projects
